description: This file defines a function to register exception handlers for a FastAPI application, including handlers for validation errors and unhandled exceptions, providing JSON responses with error details.

methods.name: None register_exception_handlers(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Registers centralized exception handlers for validation errors and general exceptions on the FastAPI app instance.

methods.name: validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError)
methods.description: Handles validation errors by returning a JSON response with a 422 status code and error details.

methods.name: unhandled_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception)
methods.description: Handles unhandled exceptions by returning a JSON response with a 500 status code and error details.

ctags.name: unhandled_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^    async def unhandled_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception):$/

ctags.name: validation_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^    async def validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError):$/
